node.statement: Validation-gated derivation (no present unconditional use of pending premises). This child requires validation of nodes 1.2 and 1.3.1. Once validated, for every n and X, node 1.2 gives ||gamma_n(X^dagger X)-gamma_n(X^dagger)gamma_n(X)||<=K_hom e||X||^2 and ||gamma_n(X^dagger)-gamma_n(X)^dagger||<=K_hom e||X||, while node 1.3.1 gives b_n<=5. By the triangle inequality and the target product-norm axiom, ||gamma_n(X^dagger X)-gamma_n(X)^dagger gamma_n(X)||<=K_hom e||X||^2+(1+epsilon)K_hom e||X||·||gamma_n(X)||<=K_hom e[1+(1+epsilon)b_n]||X||^2. If e<=1, then epsilon<=e<=1, so the bracket is at most 1+2·5=11. Hence D=11K_hom. Until both dependencies validate, this is only a conditional derivation and supplies no available conclusion.
